verdict.rationale: Anytype documents both routes in the story. Local-only mode disables Anytype's backup node entirely and keeps data on device, with offline-first local storage. The self-host docs cover pointing the client at your own network configuration and a team-maintained Docker image. A team member also confirms the p2p protocol syncs over local networks without a central server. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of running the self-hosted backend, smoother network-mode switching (it currently requires exporting channels and importing them into a new identity), and multi-device sync in local-only mode beyond the same LAN.
